title: Our cities are choked by cars – here’s how experts would fix them

paragraphs.english: This page is an independently written reading guide to Ajit Niranjan's article for The Guardian, first published online on 8 May 2026. Follow the original-article link below for the publisher's full text.
paragraphs.chinese: 本页是为 Ajit Niranjan 在《卫报》发表的文章独立撰写的阅读导读，该文于 2026 年 5 月 8 日首次在线发布。请点击下方原文链接阅读出版方提供的全文。

paragraphs.english: The article examines why reducing urban car dependence requires more than replacing petrol cars with electric ones. It presents four broad approaches: improve public transport, make streets safer and more welcoming for walking and cycling, connect suburbs to jobs and services, and understand the different reasons people rely on cars.
paragraphs.chinese: 文章探讨了为什么减少城市对汽车的依赖，不能只靠把汽油车换成电动车。它提出了四类总体思路：改善公共交通，让街道更安全、更适合步行和骑行，连接郊区与就业和服务设施，并了解人们依赖汽车的不同原因。

paragraphs.english: A central theme is that transport choices depend on whether alternatives work in daily life. A lower fare alone may not persuade people who need flexible journeys, while better routes, safer streets, reliable late-night service or nearby amenities can address more practical barriers. The article also notes that some people, including rural residents and people with particular disabilities, may have few realistic alternatives to driving.
paragraphs.chinese: 文章的一个核心观点是，交通方式的选择取决于替代方案在日常生活中是否真正可行。仅仅降低票价，可能无法说服需要灵活出行的人；更好的线路、更安全的街道、可靠的深夜服务或附近的生活设施，则可能解决更实际的障碍。文章还指出，有些人——包括农村居民和有特定残障的人士——可能几乎没有切实可行的驾车替代方式。

paragraphs.english: The discussion connects street design with the allocation of shared urban space. Bike lanes, pedestrian areas and green spaces can make other ways of travelling more attractive, but changing road use can prompt opposition. The article describes temporary trials and public consultation as ways to let residents experience changes and to identify concerns before policies are settled.
paragraphs.chinese: 文章将街道设计与城市公共空间的分配联系起来。自行车道、步行区域和绿地能让其他出行方式更有吸引力，但改变道路用途也可能引发反对。文中介绍了临时试行和公众咨询，借此让居民亲身体验变化，并在政策敲定前发现他们的顾虑。

paragraphs.english: Here is an editor-written practice sentence, not a quotation from the original article: Cities are more likely to reduce car dependence when residents can reach everyday destinations safely and reliably without driving.
paragraphs.chinese: 以下为编辑撰写的练习句，并非原文引句：当居民无需开车也能安全、可靠地到达日常目的地时，城市更有可能减少对汽车的依赖。

paragraphs.english: As you read, track how the article moves from broad goals to practical barriers and then to policy responses. Notice the contrast between measures that improve an existing service and changes that reshape streets, and ask whose needs each proposal is designed to meet.
paragraphs.chinese: 阅读时，请留意文章如何从总体目标转向实际障碍，再转向政策应对。注意比较改善现有服务的措施与重塑街道的做法，并思考每项提议旨在满足谁的需求。

sentenceNotes.sentence: Cities are more likely to reduce car dependence when residents can reach everyday destinations safely and reliably without driving.
sentenceNotes.mainClause: 主句：Cities are more likely to reduce car dependence；主语是 Cities，谓语结构是 are more likely to reduce，宾语是 car dependence。
sentenceNotes.structure: when 引导时间/条件状语从句，说明何种情况下城市更可能减少汽车依赖；residents can reach everyday destinations 为从句主干，safely and reliably 修饰 reach；without driving 表示不驾车这一方式。此句是编辑撰写的练习句，不是原文引句。
sentenceNotes.translation: 当居民无需开车也能安全、可靠地到达日常目的地时，城市更有可能减少对汽车的依赖。
sentenceNotes.tip: 先抓住主干“城市更可能减少汽车依赖”，再读 when 从句所给出的条件；without driving 修饰 reach，表示到达目的地时不需要开车。
